definition: one vehicle for five people, and what owning one of a critical thing means

settled:
A Honda Odyssey from 2015, eleven years old, is the only vehicle the five of us have. There is no second vehicle to absorb a failure window, so one failure takes road transport from the whole household at once.

It is capital we own rather than anybody I depend on. Honda matters to me for parts, manuals and recalls, not as a relationship.

Owning a single instance of something critical with nothing behind it is a shape my grading does not catch, because the grading was built for outside organisations.
